title: We don't sell charter trips.
lede: Eagle Ray Expeditions designs and leads small-group ocean expeditions combining sailing, diving, and wildlife encounters in Baja California Sur. Built for people who want more than a boat.

usPoints: The same crew, who know the channel by memory.
Adaptive routes, redrawn by weather and tide.
The water is the plan — dive, snorkel, kayak, every day.
themPoints: Neutral crew, hired by the week.
Fixed routes, printed before you meet them.
The water is scenery — watched from the cockpit.

founderQuote.kicker:
They sell trips.
We design human expeditions.
founderQuote.quote: I didn't want to sell boats. I wanted to build the kind of trip I'd actually want to be on — with people who know the ocean, not just how to hand you a set of keys.
